return_support: (endpoint-5min, endpoint]; PR=(0,+25], PC=(0,+45], state=(-60,-5] relative to PR
bipower: pi/2 times sum of adjacent absolute return products; no finite-M correction; zero BV excluded from logarithm
interpretation: bipower proxy and RV-minus-BV residual; no structural continuous/jump identification
counterfactual: non-ECB root-phase OLS: phase-pre log measure, square, lagged 5-day log RV, clock regime, trend, weekday and month indicators; PR pre endpoints -55:-5, PC pre endpoints -25:-5 relative to PC
counterfactual_validation: leave-calendar-year-out; all nuisance centering and state scaling learned on training controls
curve_primary: negative log Schatz futures return; equity is aligned fx net return; common PR-PC non-event standard-deviation units, no centering
curve_sensitivity: equal-weight mean of control-SD scaled negative Schatz and Bobl returns; same aligned equity
ois_sensitivity: EA-EMPD OIS1Y /10 and STOXX50E: original source windows, explicitly ex post for PC
phase_comparison_sample: paired PR-PC root-event complete cases within each indicator/outcome; additional common sample across all indicators
influence_ranking: meeting-level sum over phases of squared policy/equity coordinates; MP and CBI energy rankings also reported
level1_mean_surprise: EA-EMPD PR OIS1M /10, signed and absolute, plus pre-state and surprise*state, regime and asset FE
history_order: complete source GC_PR calendar before event or outcome exclusions; missing lag remains missing
sufficiency_scope: incremental predictability of these two observed history variables only; non-rejection is not Markov sufficiency
power_scope: event-level fixed-design conditional calibration along both residualized history coordinates; no universal sample-size claim
wild_null: restricted OLS, Rademacher sign per meeting shared across assets and phases, CR1 studentization, plus-one p-values
bootstrap_scope: conditional on measured indicators and fitted normal-continuation layer; generated-regressor uncertainty is not integrated
multiplicity: Holm within each declared primary family; RV, rotations, influence and alternative proxies are sensitivity families
us_release_screen: 08:30 America/New_York candidate timestamp on every weekday, exact DST; candidate is not a verified release
us_release_sensitivity: exclude any paired meeting whose PR or PC return support intersects the candidate timestamp (including boundary coincidences conservatively); refit controls on same screen
us_release_calendar_optional: Raw/Certification/us_releases.csv: release_id,timestamp_utc,source_url; actual release verification remains separate
state_standardization: pre-PR log BV only, scaled once on non-ECB complete pre-PR controls by root, independent of outcome and phase; training controls only in leave-year-out prediction
counterfactual_pc_interpretation: normal continuation conditional on the immediate pre-PC environment; this can contain PR news, and is distinct from the pre-PR interaction state
level1_sufficiency_unit: equal-weight mean of fx and gg abnormal log BV, both assets required for the meeting
us_release_mean_sensitivity: scalar PR branch excludes only PR candidate coincidences; its non-ECB controls use the same PR-only date screen
jk_rotation_sample: complete paired meeting-phase observations within the declared analysis sample; refit after top-K removal; this project-sample rotation differs from the historical full-source rotation
